claim: The same original proper smooth commutative group candidate carries an actual algebraic degree-one line sheaf H3 tensor inverse(H2), with whole-scheme rank-one frames and genuine intrinsic tensor cancellation. Its extracted full regular cocycle specializes through actual complex scheme points to the reversed coordinate-change cocycle of an independently defined 3-minus-2 hyperplane bundle; that bundle is explicitly fiber-linearly homeomorphic and locally biholomorphic to the original degree-one polarization bundle.

source_review_scopes.baseline: Exact checkpoint-manifest copies; existing provenance retained, no fresh source/kernel acceptance inferred.

obligations.name: Independent algebraic object
obligations.required_input: An analytic line or formal class is not a scheme module sheaf.
obligations.constructed_input: Use actual image sheaves, genuine intrinsic sheaf tensor and actual inverse, with explicit tensor cancellation.
obligations.justification: Use actual image sheaves, genuine intrinsic sheaf tensor and actual inverse, with explicit tensor cancellation.

obligations.name: All-prime rank-one cover
obligations.required_input: C-point nonvanishing cannot alone stand for a whole-scheme covering.
obligations.constructed_input: Use the actual projective inverse-image mixed cover, discard only empty opens, and produce a common nonempty anchor and genuine unit transition factors.
obligations.justification: Use the actual projective inverse-image mixed cover, discard only empty opens, and produce a common nonempty anchor and genuine unit transition factors.

obligations.name: Actual frame production
obligations.required_input: Pointwise ratios do not identify a categorical image.
obligations.constructed_input: Use actual Cartesian open squares, scalar-preserving base change, integral restriction monomorphisms and full row factorization to construct the same image frames.
obligations.justification: Use actual Cartesian open squares, scalar-preserving base change, integral restriction monomorphisms and full row factorization to construct the same image frames.

obligations.name: Extracted regular cocycle
obligations.required_input: Chosen analytic functions must not define the algebraic frame transition.
obligations.constructed_input: Actual global coordinate sections normalize the right frame and compute its exact coefficient in the left frame on the full original overlap ring.
obligations.justification: Actual global coordinate sections normalize the right frame and compute its exact coefficient in the left frame on the full original overlap ring.

obligations.name: Scalar and point square
obligations.required_input: An unnamed section-ring identification can change specialization.
obligations.constructed_input: Retain actual ringTop and open restriction scalar squares followed by the genuine Spec(C) appTop and GammaSpec isomorphism.
obligations.justification: Retain actual ringTop and open restriction scalar squares followed by the genuine Spec(C) appTop and GammaSpec isomorphism.

obligations.name: Correct duality convention
obligations.required_input: Same-index cocycle equality would identify the wrong dual line.
obligations.constructed_input: Prove extracted algebraic transition(a,b) evaluates to independent analytic coordinate transition(b,a), not transition(a,b).
obligations.justification: Prove extracted algebraic transition(a,b) evaluates to independent analytic coordinate transition(b,a), not transition(a,b).

obligations.name: Original degree-one comparison
obligations.required_input: A degree-three comparison does not produce degree one.
obligations.constructed_input: Construct independent mixed projective bundle and explicit original fiber map; exact t³/t²=t yields whole-base homeomorphism and local holomorphic inverses.
obligations.justification: Construct independent mixed projective bundle and explicit original fiber map; exact t³/t²=t yields whole-base homeomorphism and local holomorphic inverses.

obligations.name: Preserved tensor provenance and API repair
obligations.required_input: Baseline sources and an inherited revision must not be mislabeled fresh or exact copies.
obligations.constructed_input: Pin every baseline dependency to the1837 checkpoint and bind predecessor bytes for the sole inherited ContinuousAt.comp correction.
obligations.justification: Pin every baseline dependency to the1837 checkpoint and bind predecessor bytes for the sole inherited ContinuousAt.comp correction.

obligations.name: Remaining algebraic polarization obligations
obligations.required_input: A line bundle comparison does not itself prove ample/principal/Jacobian/PEL conclusions.
obligations.constructed_input: Keep algebraic power relation, ampleness, principality and quaternionic/Jacobian identification separate and retain hosted validation status explicitly.
obligations.justification: Keep algebraic power relation, ampleness, principality and quaternionic/Jacobian identification separate and retain hosted validation status explicitly.
